user_feedback: still see the bugs but performance feels way better
interpretation: Enabled windows reached 27.85 and 28.39 gameplay updates/s versus 27.44 and 24.09 disabled. Typical sampled update time was lower with pooling, but one later enabled window still contained a 461 ms sample. Host memory availability varied. Bounded pooled stack samples no longer caught dedicated scratch-allocation stalls; GPU-result waits remained. User reports substantially better feel, with existing visual bugs still present. This does not prove a precise speedup, complete stutter removal or visual correctness.
